intro: Anthropic is committing 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund, marking a move toward formalized social accountability in AI governance. The company has also granted outside AI watchdogs independent publishing rights, responding to mounting scrutiny over AI safety and oversight. Separately, Anthropic warned policymakers that self-replicating AI worms could become feasible by year-end if current capability trends continue, while Microsoft abandoned a major UK datacentre project due to power supply constraints.
